name: 77840 · College Sta, TX
findings: ZIP 77840 (College Sta) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77840 (College Sta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77840 (College Sta) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 21% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
